maker: Hyundai Engineering & Construction and Samsung C&T
model: Smart material transport robot (스마트 자재 운반 로봇)
name: Hyundai E&C / Samsung C&T smart material transport robot
summary: Autonomous pallet-forking transport robot developed jointly by the Korean contractors Hyundai E&C and Samsung C&T: it finds pallets and their fork holes with 3D vision, picks them up, drives by SLAM around workers and obstacles and docks itself to charge. Shown carrying a pallet of blocks on a live site in Incheon in July 2025.

germany.statusNote: In-house development of two Korean contractors, demonstrated on their own site; no sale, rental or route outside Korea.

specs.label: Pallet handling
specs.value: 3D-vision recognition of pallet shape and fork (picking) holes, automatic pick-up
specs.quote: 3D 영상을 통한 팔레트 형상 및 피킹(Picking) 홀 인식 기술

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: SLAM-based autonomous driving with worker and obstacle recognition

specs.label: Fleet control
specs.value: transport job management and remote monitoring of several robots
specs.quote: 운반 작업 관리 및 로봇 관제 기술

notes: Horizontal transport only so far; the developers plan vertical transport and more complex routes next.
No payload, speed, size or battery figures were published.
